summary: The Reserve Petroleum Company filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results and a board-approved $10.00 per share cash dividend. All eight director nominees were elected, and HoganTaylor LLP was ratified as auditor. The dividend, declared on May 19, 2026, goes to holders of record on June 3, 2026, payable June 16, 2026. This represents a substantial cash return to shareholders outside a regular quarterly pattern. There are no stated premium, deal structure, or regulatory clocks beyond standard exchange requirements. Watch for whether this signals a broader capital return policy shift or potential corporate simplification.
